paite: Paul in vaihawmte a-en kilkel a, "Unaute aw, tuni tan in Pathian mitmuh a ahoih lam hi a ka theih peuhmah hih in ka om hi,” achi hi.
Huan siampu lianpen Ananias in, Paul kiang a dinghte kiang ah, akam betsak ding thu apia hi.
Paul in akiang ah, “Nang baang nuhngou bang lelpa, Pathian in ahon beng zaw ding, nang dan bang a vaihawm ding a tu a, dan lou bang a mi bet ding na chi vial maw?" achi hi.
Huan akiang a dinghte'n, "Bangziak a Pathian siampu lianpen tai?" achi uhi.
Paul in, "Unaute aw, siampu lianpen ahi chih ka thei kei a ahi; na chipihte vaihawmte tung ah thuhoih lou gen ke'n, chih gelh ahi ngal a,” achi hi.

Paul in akhen Saddukaite, akhen Pharisaite ahi uh chih atheih in vaihawmte lak ah akikou a, "Unaute aw, Pharisai ka hi, Pharisai tapa leng ka hi; misi lametna leh thohnawnna thu ah vaihawmte mai a dinsak a om ka hi," achi hi.
Huai agentak in, Pharisaite leh Saddukaite ana kisel ua, vaihawmte akilangkhenta uhi.
Saddukaite'n, misi thohnawnna a-om kei, angelte, khate leng a-om tuan kei, achi ua; Pharisaite'n huaite teng a-om vek chih agen uhi.

Huai thu in nakpitak in abuaita ua; Pharisaite lam a mi laigelhmite khenkhat adingh ua; asel ua, "Hiai mi bangmah agitlouhna i mu kei uh; kha hiam angel hiam in akiang a thu gen hileh, eite Pathian dou suak ding i hi uh,” achi uhi.
Huan kituahlouhna lianpi ahong omtak in, sepaih heutu lianpen in Paul abohzan khak uh alau a, sepaihte kiang ah, ava hohsuk a, alak ua kipan giahbuk a va pitouh teitei ding achi hi.
Huan azan in, Paul kiang ah Toupa adingh a, “Khamuangtak in om in, Jerusalem a ka thu na theihsak bang in Rome ah leng na theisak ding hi,” achi hi.
Huan khua ahong vaktak in Judate apanghuan ua, Paul athah masiah uh bangmah ne lou dawn lou ding in akichiamta uhi.
heading: Paul Thah Sawmna

paite: Huai thubawlte sawmli sang a tamzaw ahi uh.
Amau siampu liante leh upate kiang ah ahoh ua, "Paul ka thah masiah uh bangmah chiam lou ding in ka kichiam uh achi uhi.

Huaiziak in nou vaihawmte toh athu kichian nawn sem a ngaihtuah tum bang in, na kiang ua pekhe ding in sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah ahem deuh in va gentou un; kou bel na kiangnai uh ahong tun ma a amah that dia mansa ka hi uh,” achi uhi.
Himahleh Paul sanggamnu tapa in athusawm uh ana za a, giahbuk ah ava lut a, Paul ava hilhta hi.
Paul in sepaih zaheutu khat asam a, “Hiai tangval sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah pi in, akiang ah thu banghiam gen ding nei ahih tuak,” achi hi.
Huchi in sepaih heutu lianpen kiang ah api a, "Paul, hentapa'n ahon sam a, hiai tangval na kiang a hon pi ding in ahon sawl a, na kiang ah thu banghiam gen ding nei ahih tuak,” achi hi.
Sepaih heutu lianpen in akhut in alen a, asim in atuam paipih a, "Bang ahia hon hilh ding na neih?" chi in adong hi.
Ama'n, "Paul tungtang kichian nawn sem a na ngaihtuah ding mah bang in, zingchiah vaihawmte kiang ah pisuk ding in Judate'n hon nget hoih asa chiat uh.

Himahleh athu uh na gingta ke'n; alak ua mi sawmli sang a tamzaw in thah asawm ua, huai mite'n amah athah masiah uh bangmah ne lou dawn lou ding in akichiam uh; tu in na thu ngak in mansa in a-om uhi,” achi hi.
Sepaih lianpen in tangval apaisak a, "Hiai thute na hon theisak chih kuamah hilh ke'n,” achi bikbek hi.
Huan sepaih zaheutu nih asam a, "Zan ihsip hun in Kaisaria kho pha a pai ding in sepaih zanih, sakol tungtuangmi sawmsagih, tei tawimi zanih mansa in koih un, achi hi.
heading: Kaisaria Ah Paul Sawl In A-om

paite: Huan Paul tuanna ding sakol leng na ngaihtuahsak unla, gam-ukpa Felik kiang ah bittak in tun un," achi hi.
Huan hichibang in lai agelh hi.
"Klaudias Lisias in Felik gam-ukpa hoihpa chibai abuk hi.
Hiai mi Judate'n amu ua, athah dek lai un akiang uah sepaihte pi in ka hoh a, Rome mi ahi chih ka theih in ka hunkheta hi.
Huan ahekna uh theih ut in, vaihawmte kiang ah ka pisuk a,
huchi in adan uh banghiam a hek a om ahi chih ka thei a, himahleh ahekna thu uah sihna leh henna ding bangmah ka thei kei hi.
Huan Judate'n amah tang uh ahi chih theihsak a ka omtak in, na kiang ah amah ka hon sawl ngal a, amah hekte leng atung a thubuai aneih peuh uh na ma a gen ding in thu leng ka pia hi," achi hi.
Huchi in sepaihte'n athupiak bang in Paul azanzan in api ua, Antipatris atunpih uhi.
Huan azing in sakol tungtuang mite akiang a pai zel ding in anusia ua, amau giahbuk ah akik nawnta uhi.
Huan amau Kaisaria khua atung ua, gam-ukpa kiang ah lai apia ua, Paul leng ama ah adingsak uhi.
Gam-ukpa'n asim khit in, Paul omna gam adong hi. Huan Silisia gam a pan ahi chih atheih in,
heading: Felix Ma Ah Paul

paite: "Nang hon hekte ahong tun chiang un na thubuai ka ngaihtuah ding,” achi hi. Herod thukhenna inn a ven ding thu apia hi.
